newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine shares end flat after slight correction.
newsitem.headline: Argentine shares end flat after slight correction.

text.p: Argentine shares ended flat Monday in a slight correction to a strong recovery the previous days, dealers said.
Blue chip index Merval shed 0.02 percent to close at 722.21 points.
"It was a very slight correction, selective, and aimed to consolidate prices," said Emilio Alessandro of brokers Alessandro.
Dealers said the correction could be a starting point toward new highs.
Turnover was $16.3 million, down from $18.4 million Friday. The general share index closed 0.3 percent up.
Twenty-four stocks closed higher, 21 lower and 18 unchanged.
Traders said private pension funds (AFJPs) are helping to buoy the market.
"The AFJPs are in the market," said Maximiliano Goff of Rio Research, "With them around there probably won't be so many price swings."
Of leading stocks, paper firm Celulosa rose most strongly, ending up 3.88 percent. Car maker Ciadea fell the furthest, closing 1.67 percent lower.
